dsv4_fidelity_note: DSV4 prod fidelity is anchored by its committed accuracy suites (results/acc-*.json: GSM8K/MMLU/HumanEval dev+holdout). Methodologies differ (task accuracy vs NLL-to-reference); both are deterministic and committed.
bar_assessment: DSV4 bar (467 prefill / 18.4 decode / <2 s warm TTFT) NOT met by GLM streaming: prefill 19-28 vs 467, warm decode ~1.2-1.3 vs 18.4, warm TTFT 33.5 s vs <2 s. Further levers exist (arena-pointer kernels to remove hit-path copies, batch small-suffix prefill, MTP drafting) but no measured basis is claimed for their magnitude here; the honest conclusion is the bar is not reachable with faithful routing on this hardware.
